title: shy3130/tickflow-stock-panel
claim: shy3130/tickflow-stock-panel — A self-hosted, zero-ops quant workbench for China A-shares: screening, monitoring and backtesting with an LLM co-pilot.
hook: A self-hosted quant desk for China A-shares — screen, backtest and monitor stocks with an LLM co-pilot, zero ops.
why_good: A self-hosted, zero-ops quant workbench for China A-shares: an 18-strategy screener (plus custom and AI-generated signals) that scans the whole market in milliseconds with Polars, an indicator pipeline, a backtester (T+1, fees, slippage, stop-loss), a monitoring center with voice/Feishu alerts, and AI per-stock analysis.
value: Realistically not a startup you can lift: the author's license forbids commercial use and it rides a third-party data source (TickFlow) it doesn't control. Treat it as an open reference architecture, not a business.
risk: Beyond the license and data dependency, financial tooling invites regulatory and data-licensing headaches, and the author deliberately avoids stock-picking/AI-prediction claims. The value here is the workflow blueprint, not a defensible product.

zh.claim: shy3130/tickflow-stock-panel —— 自托管、零运维的 A 股量化工作台:选股、监控、回测,配 LLM 副驾。
zh.hook: 自托管的 A 股量化工作台——选股、回测、盯盘,配一个 LLM 副驾,零运维。
zh.why_good: 一个自托管、零运维的 A 股量化工作台:18 个策略的选股器(还可自定义/AI 生成信号),用 Polars 毫秒级扫全 A 股,配指标流水线、回测(T+1/手续费/滑点/止损)、带语音/飞书提醒的监控中心,以及 AI 个股分析。
zh.value: 现实点说,它不是能直接抄去做的生意:作者的许可证明确禁止商用,而且它依赖一个自己不掌控的第三方数据源(TickFlow)。把它当开源参考架构,不是生意。
zh.risk: 除了许可证和数据源依赖,金融工具还招来监管与数据授权的麻烦,作者也刻意不做『荐股/AI 预测』。它的价值是工作流蓝图,不是有护城河的产品。
zh.does: 一个自托管、零运维的 A 股量化工作台:18 个策略的选股器(还可自定义/AI 生成信号),用 Polars 毫秒级扫全 A 股,配指标流水线、回测(T+1/手续费/滑点/止损)、带语音/飞书提醒的监控中心,以及 AI 个股分析。
zh.edge: 把散户量化的完整闭环——选股、回测、监控、复盘——打包成一套可自托管的栈(Polars/DuckDB/FastAPI),跑在你自己机器上。
zh.why_use: 如果你想要一套私有的 A 股量化台、又没有彭博的预算,它是很好的参照实现。

does: A self-hosted, zero-ops quant workbench for China A-shares: an 18-strategy screener (plus custom and AI-generated signals) that scans the whole market in milliseconds with Polars, an indicator pipeline, a backtester (T+1, fees, slippage, stop-loss), a monitoring center with voice/Feishu alerts, and AI per-stock analysis.
edge: It bundles the full retail-quant loop — screen, backtest, monitor, review — into one self-hostable stack (Polars/DuckDB/FastAPI) running on your own box.
why_use: Useful as a reference build if you want your own private A-share quant desk without a Bloomberg budget.
